insight: Singapore-based app from Sunrise AI; ranks among a16z's top 100 global consumer Gen-AI web apps.
name: SeaArt
tagline: AI art platform that turns prompts into images, videos and characters.
description: SeaArt is an AI creative platform for generating and editing images and videos and for building chat-able characters. It exposes many underlying models (Flux, Seedance, Sora, Kling, Veo and others) plus tools for upscaling, background removal and editing, wrapped around a large community gallery where users share creations, prompts and workflows. It is available on the web and as iOS and Android apps.
edge: Bundles many leading image and video models (Flux, Kling, Sora, Veo) plus a creator community and roleplay characters in one freemium app.
pros: Large community gallery with shared prompts and workflows
cons: Community content is uncurated and includes NSFW
Free tier throttled by daily credits
Output quality varies across the bundled models

references.title: The Top 100 Gen AI Consumer Apps — 6th Edition
